title: CROPS: A Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation Framework for Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the frequency of hallucinated objects that frequently co-occur with ground-truth objects in the training data (e.g., measuring how often the model hallucinates a 'person', 'cup', or 'bottle' when an image contains a 'dining table') using object-level hallucination metrics.

Measuring the model's over-reliance on past generated text tokens instead of visual evidence by tracking the decline in Visual Dependency (VD) over time and evaluating hallucination rates during the later stages of generation.
